⭐ Web Design + SEO

Web design and SEO, built together from day one.

Web design and SEO at Nifty Websites Australia means your website is designed and search-optimised at the same time, not bolted together later. Every build includes SEO-optimised content, schema markup, technical SEO and Search Console and Analytics setup, so your site is ready to rank from launch.

Get a Free Quote See how it works
$2,000SEO build included
on every website, free.
Why together

Design and SEO belong together.

Building them separately is why so many sites look fine but never get found. We build them as one.

Found from launch

The content, structure and technical setup that help you rank are built in, not added months later.

Built to convert

A site that ranks is only half the job. We design it to turn those visitors into enquiries.

Measured on results

Search Console and Analytics are connected so you can see visibility and enquiries, not guesses.

The SEO build

What the free SEO build actually includes.

Every website includes this complete SEO build, set up for you at launch.

  • SEO-optimised contentKeyword-mapped page content written to rank and to read well.
  • Schema markup on every pageSo search engines understand your business and pages.
  • Technical SEO setupFast, crawlable, indexable pages with the technical basics done right.
  • Search Console and AnalyticsConnected and configured so you can measure visibility and enquiries.
  • Local and on-page targetingTitles, headings and metadata mapped to the searches that matter.
  • Included free on every websiteA complete SEO build, set up for you at launch.
See website pricing
How it works

From search to enquiry.

Research and plan

We research the searches your customers use and map them to your pages before design.

Design around intent

We design pages that answer those searches and guide visitors to enquire.

Build with SEO baked in

We build fast and secure, then complete the SEO build across the site.

Launch and measure

We go live, connect analytics, and set you up to be found from day one.

Why Nifty

Rank and convert, not one or the other.

Complete SEO build included

Content, schema, technical setup and analytics, free on every site.

Fast, technically sound

Speed and clean structure that both users and search engines reward.

Honest about rankings

We build to the standard that ranks and never sell page-one guarantees.

Common questions

Web design and SEO, answered.

What is the difference between web design and SEO?

Web design is how a site looks and works; SEO is what helps it get found in search. When they are done together, the site is built to rank and convert from launch, instead of being redesigned or re-optimised later. That is how we build every site.

Is SEO really included, or is it an upsell?

It is genuinely included. Every website ships with a complete SEO build covering content, schema, technical setup and analytics, set up for you at launch, rather than sold separately afterwards.

Will my site rank on page one?

We build every site to the standard that ranks, with the content, structure and technical setup search engines reward, and we connect analytics so you can measure progress. We do not promise a specific position, because no honest provider can, but the site is built to rank.

Do you also do ongoing SEO?

The build sets you up to be found from launch. Ongoing SEO to keep growing rankings over time is available separately, and we can talk through what makes sense for your goals.

Common questions

Sydney web design questions, answered.

Do you build websites for businesses across Sydney?

Yes. We build for businesses right across Sydney and the surrounding suburbs, from the CBD to the outer areas, each site set up with local SEO for its area.

Will my website rank for Sydney searches?

Every website includes a complete SEO build with local optimisation, so you are positioned to rank for relevant searches in your part of Sydney. Ongoing results also depend on maintenance and competition.

How much does a website cost in Sydney?

Pricing depends on scope, not location. You receive a fixed, itemised quote after a short chat, and every site includes the SEO build. See our pricing page for guidance.

Do we need to meet in person?

No. We work with Sydney businesses entirely online, which keeps things fast and simple, though we are always a phone call away.
